# SQLite amalgamation

Sunrise vendors the official SQLite 3.53.4 amalgamation from:

```text
https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip
```

The downloaded ZIP has this official SHA3-256 value:

```text
628a44cfe82c66aed1ccbbe85a562d2e33ebe64b3288981ed76285612227934e
```

Included files:

- `sqlite3.c`
- `sqlite3.h`
- `sqlite3ext.h`

SQLite is in the public domain. See <https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html>.
